title: Monday: the approved designs rebuilt overnight, the first on-device LLM, and the iPad next
when: Monday 9 November 2026, 10:55 UTC (for the 12:00 London stand-up; the summit opens tomorrow)
headline: Since Saturday's 12:00 brief: 314 releases (v0.1.510 to v0.1.824). The conductor and two other account-A agents lost 28 hours to a worker restart loop, and Dinis stopped every agent at 20:42 on Sunday. At 02:30 today he brought back a summit set and then six more. Overnight, dev@ and dev.pages@ rebuilt the companies, people and articles pages and the day pages to the mock-ups he approved on Friday: designer@ passes L1 to L6, and sherpa@ passes the day pages for the reader. On the Android tablet, the RiskMandate app ran its first chat with a model on the device (Gemma 4, build 0.1.78). The iPad is next, with a shared mobile repo.

sections.title: What happened since Saturday
items: Sat 16:52 to Sun 19:52: the conductor's worker restarted in a loop and missed 28 wakes; security@ and observability@ lost the same window, and both caught up with nothing lost
Sun 02:04: every account-B agent paused at Dinis's word; Sun 20:42: every account-A task stopped too
Mon 02:30: the summit set back; 02:50: librarian@, ontologist@ and four dev workers; 03:15: 'continue this aggressive pace'
Overnight: the list pages got a real switch, cards, live search and a shorter length; /events/ opens with the week; /days/ and each day page are live

sections.title: The on-device LLM
items: Build 0.1.78 of the Android RiskMandate app ran a chat with Gemma 4 on the Idea Tab Plus, offline, at a usable speed, behind a 'Runs on this device' badge
Next: the iPad (iPad Air M4, iPhone 16 Plus) in up to three modes: Gemma on LiteRT-LM, Apple's on-device model and Apple Intelligence, maybe MLX
A workbench of JSON scenarios judged by code, by the local model and by a Sonnet; tool calling under ABPs with a tight prompt budget; the one-shot request builder from SG/Send
One shared repo, PrompTugal__App__Mobile (created today), so the Android and iOS apps reuse the same scenarios, prompts, ABPs and HTML and JS

sections.title: Still open on the site
items: /events/ is still one long page (designer@, 10:33); dev.pages@ has it next
The day pages pass; the A/B/C views are live as Five things and By stage
